tests.procedure: Under strong white light, check each received sample container separately in clean, transparent watch glass to detect any foreign particles, conformance of colour & compliance with the visual specifications. Hygroscopicity: weigh vessel and stopper (m1), add ~2 g substance (m2), place un-stoppered in climatic cabinet at 25 ± 1 °C for 24 h, stopper and weigh (m3). Calculate percentage increase in mass.

details.bp_text: White or almost white, fine or granular, slightly hygroscopic powder.
details.usp_text: Fine, white or almost white powder. It consists of free-flowing, nonfibrous particles.

tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:30

tests.procedure: Weigh 100 mg of sample in a stoppered tube. Stepwise add solvent: 0.1 mL, 0.9 mL, 2 mL, 7 mL with 1 min vigorous shaking and 15 min hold at 25.0 ± 0.5 °C; if undissolved test 10 mg in 10 mL then 1 mg in 10 mL. Repeat with specified solvents.
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:31

tests.procedure: Mix intimately with potassium bromide and compress into a transparent pellet. Disregard any band between 800 cm-1 and 825 cm-1 or between 950 cm-1 and 1000 cm-1. Compare spectrum with microcrystalline cellulose CRS / RS.
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:32

tests.procedure: Place about 10 mg on a watch-glass, disperse in 2 mL of iodinated zinc chloride solution. The substance becomes violet-blue.
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:32

tests.procedure: Shake 5 g with 40 mL of carbon dioxide-free water for 20 min, centrifuge, use supernatant. Measure with calibrated pH meter.
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:33

tests.procedure: Use supernatant obtained in pH test. Measure conductivity of supernatant and conductivity of the water used to prepare the test solution using calibrated conductivity meter. Difference must not exceed 75 µS·cm-1.

details.samplePreparation: Supernatant from pH test (5 g in 40 mL water)
details.blank: Water used to prepare test solution
details.limit: Supernatant conductivity does not exceed water conductivity by more than 75 µS·cm-1

tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:34

tests.procedure: Place 10.0 g (W1) in a chromatography column (~20 mm id), pass 50 mL peroxide-free ether. Evaporate eluate to dryness in tared dish, dry residue at 105 °C for 30 min, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2). Carry out blank determination. Limit: max 0.05% (5.0 mg difference between residue and blank).
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:35

tests.procedure: Shake 5.0 g (W1) with 80 mL water for 10 min, filter through filter paper with vacuum into tared flask. Evaporate to dryness on water bath avoiding charring, dry at 105 °C for 1 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2). Carry out blank determination. Limit: max 0.25% (12.5 mg difference between residue and blank).
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:36

tests.procedure: Accurately weigh empty weighing bottle previously dried at 105 °C and cooled in desiccator (W0). Weigh accurately 1.000 g into bottle (W1 = empty bottle + sample). Dry in calibrated oven at 105 °C for 3 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2). Repeat to constant weight. % LOD = ((W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0)) x 100.

details.formula: % Loss on Drying = ((W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0)) x 100

tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:37

tests.procedure: Accurately weigh empty platinum crucible previously ignited at 600-650 °C and cooled in desiccator (W0). Weigh 1.0 g sample into crucible (W1 = crucible + sample). Moisten with ~1 mL sulfuric acid, char gently on hot plate, moisten with sulfuric acid, heat until white fumes cease, ignite in muffle at 600-650 °C, cool, weigh (W2). Repeat to constant weight. % = ((W2 - W0) / (W1 - W0)) x 100.
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:38

tests.procedure: Weigh empty cylinder. Slowly pour powder above funnel. Weigh filled cup. Calculate bulk density by dividing powder weight by cylinder volume.
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:39

tests.procedure: Dissolve ~10 g sample in SCDB with 4% polysorbate 20 to 100 mL homogeneous suspension. Plate count / membrane filtration per SOP C2I-91-128 and verification report.
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:40

tests.procedure: Dissolve ~10 g sample in SCDB with 4% polysorbate 20 to 100 mL homogeneous suspension. Plate count / membrane filtration per SOP C2I-91-128 and verification report.
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:40

tests.procedure: Take 10 mL prepared SCDB dilution into 90 mL SCDB, incubate at 30-35 °C for 18-24 h. Transfer 1 mL to 100 mL MacConkey broth, incubate 42-44 °C 24-48 h, subculture on MacConkey agar at 30-35 °C 18-72 h.
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:41

tests.procedure: Incubate prepared SCDB dilution at 30-35 °C 18-24 h. Transfer 0.1 mL to 10 mL Rappaport Vassiliadis broth, incubate 30-35 °C 18-24 h, subculture on XLD agar at 30-35 °C 18-48 h.
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:42

tests.procedure: Subculture from incubated SCDB on Mannitol Salt Agar (MSA) plate, incubate 30-35 °C 18-72 h. Golden yellow or white colonies with yellow zone indicate S. aureus; confirm by Gram stain, coagulase kit, and identification system.
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:43

tests.procedure: Subculture from incubated SCDB on Cetrimide Agar Medium (CAM), incubate 30-35 °C 18-72 h. Confirm colonies by Gram stain, oxidase test, catalase test, Burkholderia cepacia agar, and identification system.
tests.source: Microcrystalline Cellulose 102__STM Microcrystalline Cellulose with merge.txt:44
